docs.tabs.a11y.activation: Selection follows the focus: moving to a tab selects it and calls onChange, so the panel matches the tab that has the focus. A click works the same way. The exception is a controlled parent that refuses the change: the focus goes to the tab, and the selection stays where it was.
docs.tabs.a11y.focus: Keyboard focus is drawn with the focus ring token, on the tab and on the panel. A click does not draw it.
docs.tabs.a11y.keyboard: The arrow keys move between the tabs and wrap around at the ends, and Home and End go to the first and the last. Only the selected tab is in the tab order, so Tab leaves the list instead of crossing every tab.
docs.tabs.a11y.name: label names the tab list, and a screen reader reads it when the focus enters. Say what the tabs switch between, not «Tabs».
docs.tabs.a11y.panel: The panel is the next stop after the tab list, so a keyboard user reaches its content, and can scroll it, even when it holds nothing focusable.
docs.tabs.a11y.pattern: It follows the ARIA tabs pattern: a tablist that holds a tab for each item, and a tabpanel for each one. A tab says which panel it controls with aria-controls and is selected with aria-selected, and each panel is named by its tab.
docs.tabs.a11y.strings: Tabs has no text of its own: the labels of the tabs, the panels and label are yours, in the language of your page, and a FormaProvider changes nothing here.
docs.tabs.api.className: Added to the element that wraps the tab list and the panels.
docs.tabs.api.defaultValue: The tab that starts selected when value is not set. A value that matches no item selects the first one.
docs.tabs.api.items: The tabs, in order, each with its panel. The fields of an item are listed below.
docs.tabs.api.label: The accessible name of the tab list. Say what the tabs switch between («Project sections»), not «Tabs».
docs.tabs.api.onChange: Called with the id of the tab that the user selects, by click or with the keyboard. It is also called when the tab that is already selected is selected again.
docs.tabs.api.value: The selected tab, which makes the component controlled: it changes only when this prop does. A value that matches no item selects the first one.
docs.tabs.controlled.description: With value and onChange the parent owns the selection: it can show it somewhere else, or refuse a change. Without them, Tabs keeps it itself.
docs.tabs.controlled.hint: The line under the tabs reads the state of the parent.
docs.tabs.controlled.title: Controlled
docs.tabs.item.content: What the panel shows. Only the panel of the selected tab renders it.
docs.tabs.item.id: Identifies the tab. It builds the ids of the tab and of its panel, and it is the value that value, defaultValue and onChange use. It must be unique.
docs.tabs.item.label: What the tab shows. Keep it to text and icons.
docs.tabs.item.title: Fields of each item ({component})
docs.tabs.limit.activation: Activation is automatic only: there is no option to select with Enter or Space after moving. Use Tabs when showing a panel is quick.
docs.tabs.limit.color: The selected tab is told apart by color only: its background and its text change, and its shape does not. Assistive technology gets the state from aria-selected, but a person who cannot tell the two colors apart has no other cue. A mark that is not color is a pending design decision.
docs.tabs.limit.disabled: There is no disabled tab. An item that cannot be used yet is left out, or its panel says why.
docs.tabs.limit.ids: The id of each item must be unique and must not contain spaces: it is part of the ids of the tab and of its panel.
docs.tabs.limit.label: A tab is a button, so its label should be text or an icon, not another control: the arrow keys are handled for the whole list and would reach a control inside a tab too.
docs.tabs.limit.mounted: Only the content of the selected panel is rendered. What another panel held, such as a half-written form, is gone when the user moves away: keep that state in the parent.
docs.tabs.limit.orientation: The list is horizontal: ArrowUp and ArrowDown do nothing, and in right-to-left text the arrows keep their directions.
docs.tabs.limit.wrap: The tabs wrap onto more lines when they do not fit, and they never scroll. A few short labels keep the list on one line.
docs.tabs.states.description: A tab is selected or it is not, and hover and keyboard focus are drawn on top of that. All of it works here: point at a tab, or press Tab and then the arrow keys.
docs.tabs.summary: Panels that share one place: a list of tabs and the panel of the selected one.
docs.tabs.usage.description: Import Tabs and give it a label and the items. Each item has an id, the label of its tab and the content of its panel.
